description: Result returned by the independent skill evaluator: one finding per requirement.

findings.description: Exactly one finding per requirement supplied in bundle.json. There is no aggregate score or release decision.

id.description: Exact requirement ID this finding grades, copied verbatim from the supplied requirements.

status.description: Verdict for the requirement: 'pass' if substantively satisfied, 'fail' if the required behavior is missing or wrong, 'ungradable' if evidence is missing or unusable (use this instead of failing for execution problems).

evidence.description: Supporting statements for the verdict, required for every status including pass. Each entry cites specific paths, task/criterion IDs, and short excerpts or precise descriptions. For omissions, name the required behavior and where evidence was expected; for ungradable, explain why.
